module: GE extension `core_vehicle_partFocusCamera`: drives the hidden camera mode 'partFocus' from the parts menu. From the selected parts, computes a bounding box (size from the meshes, position from the jbeam nodes, which follow the vehicle live), sets the camera distance to frame it (FOV 35°, margin 1.2) and moves it smoothly. Requests wait 0.5 s for the selection to stabilize, unless the immediate option is set. Gives the camera back to the player when the selection stays empty.
notes: cameraOptions accepts: immediate (skips the wait delay), focusOffsetUp (offset of the target toward the top of the vehicle, m), distanceMultiplier (multiplier of the framing distance) and preserveDistance (do not recompute the distance).
Internal constants: settleDelay 0.5 s, transitionTime 1.2 s, minExtent 0.15 m (a part held by a single node does not shrink to a point).

updateTarget is called by the partFocus camera mode itself (not by the onUpdate hook) to read node positions at the right moment of the frame; it draws the bounding box (debugDrawer:drawLine) on every call, including outside debug.
M.onSerialize points to M.clear (which returns nothing): no data is saved and the camera is released before a Lua reload; M.onExtensionUnloaded also points to M.clear.

debugDrawPivot.desc: false by default; true marks the center of the box with a sphere.

focusOnParts.desc: Asks the camera to frame a set of parts. Repeated identical requests are ignored (the delay is not restarted). An empty list falls back to release().

selectedMeshes.desc: part meshes (provided by core_vehicle_partmgmt), used to measure the size

cameraOptions.desc: see notes: immediate, focusOffsetUp, distanceMultiplier, preserveDistance

release.desc: Gives the camera back to the player once the selection stays empty for settleDelay (0.5 s), or immediately.

clear.desc: Cancels the requests, leaves the partFocus mode (back to the previous camera, 'orbit' by default) and removes the PartCamera action map.

isActive.desc: Indicates whether the part camera is active (a vehicle is framed).

zoomStep.desc: Adds mouse wheel notches (zoom) to be applied by the camera mode.

consumeZoomSteps.desc: Returns and resets the accumulated zoom notches (called by the camera mode).

updateTarget.desc: Called by the partFocus camera mode every frame: periodically re-measures the box, rebuilds the box in world space, draws it and sets the camera's aim point.

onUpdate.desc: Per-frame hook: counts down the wait delay (real time, because the configuration menu often runs paused) then applies the request or releases the camera.

onVehicleResetted.desc: Hook: the vehicle is reset; forces an immediate re-measure of the box.

onVehicleDestroyed.desc: Hook: the framed vehicle is destroyed; releases the camera.

onVehicleSpawned.desc: Hook: the framed vehicle is recreated; keeps the last camera pose.

onVehicleSwitched.desc: Hook: the driven player leaves the framed vehicle; releases the camera.

onVehicleConfigTargetChanged.desc: Hook: the configuration target changes; releases the camera.
